The GPS tracker and kill switch has its own page: the tracker is free for vehicle owners, and you pay the install and the monthly service; join the list there to hear first when trackers arrive

Each car's page shows Tracker alerts with the time and the place, never the renter or the booking. Told at once, each its own switch in your notification preferences: possible theft (also leaving Ontario or Canada), the tracker disconnected or tampered with, a crash, an impound lot, auto shop or shipping port (on to start with), a health warning and over 180 km/h (off to start with); harsh braking, late-night driving and kilometres against the allowance come in a weekly driving summary you can turn on

A Rewards tab: 20% off another CarmaCars car while yours is out, a free upgrade to ask for when a repair is on us, a friends and family code, link and QR code (10% off their first rental, 20% of it to you), $100 for referring an owner, a $25 birthday rental credit, priority support and early access
Merch kits at 6 and 12 months: press Redeem, confirm your address, and follow it to Shipped
Notification preferences under Account: push, email and text for each kind, quiet hours, and a daily or weekly summary; new-booking notices are yours to turn on

Charges during a booking of your own car are due at once and are taken from your payment method on file; otherwise you get an invoice with a pay link, and an unpaid one comes off your next statement. Each charge is listed with its evidence
The Late Fee on insurance not paid on time is 5% of the unpaid insurance (it was $50), plus HST; you are reminded 3 days before the due date
renters: With your phone's permission, your location shows to our team only two hours either side of your pickup or return, so we can meet you; turn it off in Account, Profile, Location on the live map
The rental agreement adds non-return, improper return, theft recovery and tire and roadside charges, each billed with its evidence; roadside assistance stays included
Something to fix on your profile (your phone, a licence about to expire, a name that differs) shows in one box with the fix
Checking in yourself? Confirm it is you with a photo of your licence and a selfie. It is optional and never holds up your pickup
The rental agreement has speeding charges over 180, 220 and 300 km/h (section 10.5); agreements already signed stay as they are
The privacy policy and the rental agreement say that CarmaCars staff and the car's owner can see where the car is
The rental agreement says that taking the car out of Canada always needs our written approval before you leave (10.1)
The rental agreement's speeding clause (10.5) is clearer: one speeding event is one charge, at the highest limit reached; you are asked to accept the updated wording once

If the car's Tracker records speeding over 180 km/h, the car outside Ontario or at an impound lot, we tell you at once what happened, any charge and the clause of your agreement; a friendly heads-up comes first when you are well over the limit, with no charge
Your booking page says when the deposit is still owed and how to place it
Your booking's checklist says exactly which insurance page is still missing, and its button opens that upload
Example pictures of a pink slip and an OPCF 27 endorsement page, with the parts that must show circled, and how to take the photo
A pay link asks only for what you owe; one you no longer need is cancelled by itself and never charged
We email you about your Rewards points, your tier and your free day, and a reminder before points end
From Platinum up, a rental near your birthday or on a holiday weekend costs less; add your birthday on the Rewards page
On a payment plan, your booking is confirmed as soon as your first payment is in
Paying the deposit by e-Transfer, cash or debit? Your offer and pay page show that amount (twice the card deposit) before you pay
Add a tip for the team when you pay, on your booking after the trip or from the link in the Returned email: 10, 15 or 20%, or any amount

Notification preferences under Account: push, email and text for each kind, quiet hours, and a daily or weekly summary. Booking confirmations and changes, return reminders, receipts, charges, legal notices and security codes are always sent
Investors and partners have the same notification preferences on their portals; the app uses the same choices

r49.summary: Gift cards and gifted rentals, a Finance dashboard with every bank line matched, automatic checks that every event has its message and the guides match the app, and overdue and late-return notices.

renters: Give a CarmaCars gift card or a gifted rental from the footer's Gift cards: any amount, emailed with your message on the day you choose, and it never expires. Got one? Add the code under Rewards, Gift cards; on Sign and pay the balance is used before your card.
admins: Finance (Company, first tab): cash in the bank and at Stripe with the payouts on the way, free cash after deposits, payouts, refunds and HST, money in and out of the month, HST for the quarter, renter balances overdue, insurer invoices by age and twelve months of money in and out

Bank lines: drop the RBC download (CSV or OFX); each line is kept once, matched by itself to its card processor payout, payment, payout or expense when one record fits, and the rest becomes a To do for Finance
Money > Gift cards: what is owed on gift cards, every card and its history; issue a voucher (an amount or a percentage), void with a reason, resend.
Check e-Transfer on Today: an e-Transfer Sales reported, with Confirm received and Not received (also on the connector)
staff: Finance has the same Finance page under Money, with the bank import and the matching of bank lines
Finance: Money > Gift cards: the liability outstanding and every card's balance history.

Sales: Renter sent an e-Transfer on a booking waiting for payment sends the amount and the screenshot to Finance, who confirm it in one tap (it is then recorded and the booking confirmed) or send it back with the reason
owners: Owners are told once when their car is 2 hours late coming back

r50.summary: Owners sign their agreement before any car comes over, card payments move to a new Canadian card processor with e-Transfer whenever cards are off, field expenses say whose money paid, and every car is shown in one studio look whose renders now actually finish.

renters: Renters add notes to an open request and choose who referred them, so that person is credited
Your booking counts down to the pickup, live, and Add to calendar puts the pickup and return in Apple Calendar, Google Calendar or Outlook
Your steps from the request to the final statement are a line of checkpoints that tick as you go, with a finish flag at the end
Play a game a day in Rewards for points

Guide me, at the top of your account and on the sign-up and booking pages: pick what you want to do (create your account, book a car, add your licence, sign and pay, pay by e-Transfer, pickup day, extend, return, your deposit, rewards) and a small card shows the next step. It is optional and never in the way.

On the car page and in the booking form you choose: Request to book (no charge; we check and send you a pay link or an offer) or Book instantly (Gold Rewards members: pay now and the car is confirmed). With card payments paused, Book instantly is paid by Interac e-Transfer.
Card payments now open the card processor's secure card window (Sign and pay, pay links, add-ons, gift cards). CarmaCars never sees the card number.
For a rental longer than 7 days the deposit is charged and refunded after the rental instead of held; the pay page says so.

While card payments are paused, Sign and pay shows how to pay by Interac e-Transfer (the email, your booking number as the message and the exact amounts) and you upload the screenshot; we confirm it and email you.
Every car's photos now look the same: the same studio, the same angles, the car the same size in every photo

On a rental of about a month or longer, your trips page shows Next check-in visit: around a date: a quick, free visit to keep the car in top shape and catch maintenance early. Nothing to pay. A few days before, we remind you; Pick a time at our office or By request.

Returning the car is never blocked: documents still being checked, the deposit, the agreement or money owed never stop a return, even when your pickup was never recorded (it is then recorded at your booked time). A licence approved on an earlier booking counts on every booking until it expires, and your booking asks only for what is really still missing
owners: Your application and each car's onboarding are a line of checkpoints that tick as you go; play a game a day in Rewards for points
What you could earn now depends on your car's year as well as its make and model: an older car is estimated lower, a newer one higher
Guide me, at the top of the owner portal and on the application page: step by step through applying, your profile, signing, adding a car, statements and payouts, invoices and documents

Your next step, on Home and each car's page: every step of your car's onboarding (Transfer, Co-Registrant or Lease), the one thing to do now with its button, what to bring, where to go (the ServiceOntario centre finder) and how long it takes. You are emailed and texted when a step is yours

Upload your licence, the lender's letter, corporate documents, the UVIP, the safety certificate and the new ownership permit on the car's page; book your ServiceOntario visit and press Transfer done after it
Need a corporation for the lease route? Incorporate now opens our online incorporation partner

You sign your agreement first, filled in from your profile, before any car comes over. Your portal shows six steps (profile, agreement, cars, photos, approval, delivery) with one button for the next thing to do
Each car you add goes on Schedule A of your agreement; you confirm new cars with one signature. Fleet suppliers can add cars from a list of VINs with each car's tier and plate
A long rental shows the rental charge for all its days and what your statements carried so far
A rental whose pickup was not recorded shows as out, not available
Signed copies show the CarmaCars countersignature in its place; corrected copies are filed and you are told
Your car page lists the monthly check-in visits of long rentals: the date, the kilometres, the tire tread and the car's condition as we found it
admins: To do's close by themselves once their subject is settled, one booking's one problem keeps one To do, and week-old follow-ups expire, every hour, each with its reason
Data health "Mark picked up" and "Close" now work for a car already out with no deposit or signed report: the pickup is recorded at the booked time and what is owed becomes To do's
You hear 30 minutes before a car is due back and at the return time, and the moment a new request comes in
Phone alerts stay on after the app signs out and back in
Self-healing keeps one bug report for each problem, counts it and closes it by itself once the problem is gone

Hotfix: every car shows its photo again (the cards, the car pages and the home hero no longer show an empty studio); the top bar keeps the bell and an Account menu (Profile, Academy, the assistant, What's new, Guide, Guide me, Report a bug, Sign out); Add shifts, townhalls and interviews to Google Calendar also puts the weekly townhall and every booked interview call in your calendar

Hotfix 2: studio photos that can pass: Gemini makes each car alone and the site puts it on the same dealership background with the CarmaCars sign and the car's name, in the order of the sample photos, then the car's real outside photos cut out the same way; check-in photos are used when a car has no photos; each view gets at most 3 tries a day, every Gemini image counts in the daily photo budget, and the studio pauses with an alert when it spends too much for each photo that passes

Field shifts in your Google Calendar: on Field jobs, Add shifts, townhalls and interviews to Google Calendar gives you a private link with every field shift (who claimed it or Open, the tasks, a link to it), 14 days back to 60 ahead; one click adds it to Google, which refreshes it every few hours. No email

Far fewer emails: only what needs you now comes by email (a card dispute, a failed payment on a confirmed booking, a security alert, a booked live interview, a request to book no salesperson holds, an urgent To do). Everything else is in the bell and in one email at 7:00 am, counted by type with a link per kind. Switch Email on for a kind in Notifications to get it as it happens
One website crash To do per error, not one per page: it counts the reports and lists the pages, and closes by itself after 24 hours with no new report. The old per-page ones were merged

Company documents (Settings): the shareholder agreement, articles, franchise agreement, insurance policy, lease and other corporate papers, Admins only, every version kept. A text to sign (with its fill-ins) is signed here by the Admins named, with the site's own signature; when everyone has signed, the signed copy is filed and each signer is told by email (it opens in Admin only). The connector: list_company_documents, company_document_upload and company_document_fields

Resignations: staff resign in their portal; you and Finance get an alert and an Offboarding To do (final pay, keys and equipment, jobs and shifts to reassign, what to hand back). Staff and roles shows Resigning with the last day and the reason; change the last day, withdraw it, end access now, or Record a resignation for someone who resigned by email. Access ends by itself after the last day; list_staff shows it

Calls inside the site, on our own server: the weekly townhall and video interviews no longer need an outside link. You present the townhall: your slide is everyone's, and People shows who is in, who left and who has not joined; attendance is recorded by itself. Interview candidates join from the link in their email (it works in one browser only) and you see their details, the rubric and No show / Not hired beside the video. If the call server is ever down, Switch to the outside link on the Townhall page.

Calendar invites go out by themselves: every staff member and Admin has the weekly townhall in their calendar (sent to the whole team now, then to each new hire); changing the day or time sends the update, a townhall you cancel ahead is taken off everyone's calendar. Interview candidates get the call in their calendar when they book, moved when they move it, removed when it is cancelled.

Renters choose Book instantly or Request to book; each booking records the choice. A Book instantly that could not go through lands in your requests with the chip Asked to book instantly and the reason: answer it first.
Report a bug works while a pop-up, drawer or sheet is open: the button shows at the bottom left, and the report's picture and details show the pop-up.
Cards run on the new processor: set its keys as in docs/ops/helcim-setup.md. Until then cards are off and renters pay by e-Transfer.

Card payments in Program settings: one switch (and the card processor's own answer, checked by itself) turns every card form into e-Transfer instructions with a screenshot upload; you are alerted once when the card processor stops taking payments
While card payments are paused, Collect a card, card links and deposit holds are off; the Money tab says Ask the renter to e-Transfer with the message ready to copy
The connector reads the new processor (its account, its payments, and records one a booking missed); add_expense and list_expenses know whose money paid.
Agreements before cars on an owner's page and application: exactly what is missing and who it waits on, with Send reminder
A car is approved, delivered or rented only once its owner signed; an approval made before goes through by itself when they sign
Change the method: correct a car's Onboarding Method before its Vehicle Schedule is signed
Document check (Owners): anything inconsistent on an owner's agreements, schedules or forms, by owner, with what fixes it
A car whose pickup was not recorded takes no new offer until the handover, the return or a no-show is recorded

The connector adds a car for an owner from its VIN, approves an owner's cars with their terms (a fleet supplier's car goes on the lease with its agreement and forms to sign), puts a car on the fleet lease, and reads and corrects owner agreements and documents

The connector runs the weekly townhall: townhall_status (next meeting, call link, this week's deck, which staff are on it and which are missing, reminders, field-call slots), townhall_set_call_url and townhall_rebuild_deck (rebuilds this week's deck from live data and keeps the notes), each change previewed, then confirmed.

The townhall deck adds, from live data: Website visitors (a day this week against last week, and the 4-week trend), the Top incident of the week (picked automatically from tracker alerts, incidents, claims, damage and late returns; Choose another to pick or describe it yourself), Disputes and chargebacks (this week and the month to date, open, won and lost; the amounts on an Admin-only slide), Birthdays (this week and next), KPIs hit this week (a line for every active staff member), and the cars added and removed by name on the fleet slide. Still 30 minutes. Add a staff member's birthday from the staff list.

Studio renders are made again across the fleet: a photo step that timed out or was refused three times is flagged on Photo standard with the reason instead of being tried for ever, so the other cars' renders go ahead
Photos filed as "Other detail" (imports the sorter could not read) are sorted again by themselves, so a car's outside photos become its cover

Connector: site_errors (the site's server and browser errors by page and message), site_health (site checks and data health problems) and search_console_issues (pages Google sees with 5xx, 404 and other errors, sitemap problems), all read only; the server's own errors are now recorded too
Connector: photo_standard shows a rendered cover as studio, and per car the detail photos still to sort

Connector, for dispute evidence (read only): list_comms (every call, text, chat and email of a renter or booking, card and ID numbers taken out), get_call_recording (transcript and a 10-minute audio link), get_id_check (ID checks with licence and selfie links), get_booking_invoice (base rate, add-ons, HST), full chat threads in list_chats, and signed links in get_agreement (with signer IP and time), list_booking_photos and photo_standard; recording and ID access is in the audit log; stripe_find_payments and stripe_booking name the payer (receipt, billing and Customer email, name and phone, card fingerprint) and matched_renter with candidate bookings and their open amounts
Studio renders made before the new standard stay on the site while each is checked in place; only those the check refuses are made again, the most viewed and bookable cars first
Only studio views that passed the consistency check are on the site; Photo standard > Studio grid shows each car's nine views side by side with why any was refused
Academy: Guide me walkthroughs by staff member (started, completed, stopped) and the step people stop at most in each workflow

Check-in visits (Cars): long rentals (28 days or more, long-term weekly, rideshare drivers) get a free monthly visit, on by default. Program settings: on or off, the length, the days between visits (30), the reminder lead (5 days), the office slots. Each booking has its own switch on its booking page; visits show on the booking timeline and the owner's car page.
Onboarding steps on the owner page: each car's step and whose turn it is; Advance this step or Override a step (kept in the audit log). Owner pipeline (Marketing) shows every car by step
Settings > Incorporation referral: paste the affiliate link (off until then), see who was referred and record the commission
staff: Fleet and field staff: Add shifts, townhalls and interviews to Google Calendar (Field jobs, My shifts, Profile; field staff: Add my shifts and townhalls to Google Calendar) puts the shifts and the weekly townhall in your Google Calendar by a private link; Google updates it every few hours
The top bar keeps the bell and an Account menu: Profile, Academy, the assistant, What's new, Guide, Guide me, Report a bug and Sign out are in it

Resign in your portal: the last section of your Profile (on Welcome while you are still in onboarding). Choose your last day (7 days' notice by default), add a reason if you like, see what happens next and confirm; you get an email with your final pay timing and what to return, and you can withdraw it until your last day
Sales: Call and Text work again on every lead and client, even when two numbers look alike behind the hidden digits (BR-4)
Admins: Renter approved by phone goes through after the coverage or the charges changed: the renter's offer is updated to the current charges and approved in one step, noted in the history (BR-3)

The townhall's Platform updates slide shows the week's releases and the bugs fixed: how many, what was wrong, what was fixed and who reported it (thanks to everyone who uses Report a bug), with the bugs still open

The townhall call is in the site: no outside link. Join from Townhall (from 15 minutes before) with your camera on; the slides follow the presenter beside the video, and you can raise your hand, chat and share your screen. Being in the call counts your attendance by itself, and it works on a phone

The weekly townhall is in your calendar: every staff member gets an email with a calendar invite that repeats every week (Toronto time); accept it once. A new day or time, or a townhall cancelled ahead, updates your calendar by itself
Birthday on your profile (optional, month and day only): the team celebrates it at the weekly townhall

Guide me covers more of your work: tolls, Turo trips, payroll, field spending, payments by day, maintenance, your hours, marketing, leads, finding a renter, your first days, the academy, field shifts and pay. Its menu lists the workflows of the page you are on first
Sales: Owner pipeline shows your owners' cars by step, days in the step and the next action; Nudge sends a branded email and text; each step has a call script. A step waiting 3 days gives you a To do
Fleet: a To do when a car needs its fleet policy or its inspection; record the inspection on the owner page
A request marked Asked to book instantly is a Gold renter whose instant booking could not go through: answer it first, with a pay link or an offer.
Report a bug works while a pop-up is open: use the button at the bottom left of the screen.

Guide me, at the top of every page: choose a job and a small card points at the next thing to fill or press, with Step X of Y. It moves on by itself once you have really done it; Back, Skip and Exit are always there, and it picks up where you were. Tick Keep Guide me on to have it offer on each job's first page, or press Guide me through this on the page
Fleet: Photo standard > Studio grid shows every car's nine views side by side; the site shows only views marked Live
Fleet and customer service see Agreements before cars on the owner page and can send the reminder
Fleet gets a To do for every confirmed rental whose pickup was not recorded
Field staff choose whose money paid each expense; what is owed to you is on My shifts and paid back on the payroll

Check-in visits (Fleet: Checks; customer service: Renters; field work: Today): do the monthly visit of a long rental with the checklist; you are told when a renter picks a time and the morning of a visit. Guide me: Do a check-in visit walks you through it

Record pickup at the booked time on a booking whose pickup was never recorded, and a renter's return report records it by itself: Admin and Fleet are told, and Fleet gets a To do with what is still owed and the documents to review. Approving a licence on one booking now approves it on the renter's other bookings
investors: Business documents under Documents: the CarmaCars business plan, financial forecast, pitch deck and feature decks, each at its latest version with the date it was updated. We email you, and show a notice in your portal, when one is added or updated
What's new at CarmaCars on Home and on Updates: what each release of the platform added, in plain words
Guide me at the top of the investor portal: your dashboard, statements and documents to sign, step by step
How the business is growing on Home, and Traction on the deck: monthly active users of the website and the app, and the days rented each month
